item.title: Greetings from Paris, where the 2024 Olympics balloon rises again
item.description: The floating Olympic cauldron, held aloft by a giant glowing balloon, is still making regular appearances two years after the 2024 Paris Games, showing up all summer long in the nighttime Paris sky.
item.content:encoded: The floating Olympic cauldron, held aloft by a giant glowing balloon, is still making regular appearances two years after the 2024 Paris Games, showing up all summer long in the nighttime Paris sky.

item.title: U.S. military destroys 5 Iranian oil tankers. And, the Smithsonian head resigns
item.description: The U.S. military says it has destroyed five Iranian oil tankers as the conflict continues to escalate. And, Smithsonian head Lonnie G. Bunch III says he plans to step down by the end of the year.
item.content:encoded:
The U.S. military says it has destroyed five Iranian oil tankers as the conflict continues to escalate. And, Smithsonian head Lonnie G. Bunch III says he plans to step down by the end of the year.

item.title: Citing the 'Deep State,' Trump overhauls the intelligence community
item.description: The catastrophic 9/11 attacks forced the intelligence community to radically revamp its ways of doing business. Now, critics say, President Trump is dismantling much of what was built since then.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Iceland summons U.S. ambassador after Trump posts countries draped with American flag
item.description: Iceland summoned the U.S. ambassador after President Trump posted a map on Truth Social that showed the country, along with a number of other nations, covered with an American flag.

item.title: U.S. military says it destroyed 5 Iranian oil tankers after attacks on Navy warship
item.description: The U.S. military said it destroyed five Iranian oil tankers on Tuesday in response to the latest attacks on its warships. Iran hit American targets in Jordan.

item.title: Australian social media users to be offered choice to opt out of algorithms
item.description: A government statement said on Tuesday social media platforms would be required to send a notification to new and existing users offering them a choice over their default feed.

item.title: U.K. accuses Israeli settlers of 'ethnic cleansing' in West Bank and bans their goods
item.description: France, Canada and other countries joined the U.K. in banning goods from Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank. Israel said it would close the British Consulate among other measures.
